maya: Quick thread — parity scan between int8 qbringup and fp16 baseline showed regression on long-context prompt subset.
maya: pass@1 delta -3.2%, hallucination rate +2.9% (sampled subset 'edge-dialogue-long').
leo: on it. can you paste the eval diff and config?
maya: simple summary below:
```
model: qbringup-int8-calibA
baseline: fp16-2025-02-28
subset: edge-dialogue-long (n=1200)
metrics: pass@1 -3.2, exact-match -1.8, halluc +2.9
cfg: kv_cache=true, batch_size=1, quant_type=int8, tokenizer=v2.1(abc123)
```
jordan: did you run with the same logits temp/recall reranking? small tweaks there blow up longform.
maya: yes rerank top-k=5, temp=0.0, rescoring using embed-dot
anita: FYI label ops: fallback routing tripped this morning -> ~90% labeler queue usage; we had to flip to manual fallback for golden routing.
ops-bot: deploy-canary: canary 2025-03-01T10:05 finished — no OOMs, GPU util within expected.
sasha: my 2c: looks like quant calibration drift on tails. suggest add 200 longctx golden samples focused on hallucinations + run tokenizer parity test with v1. also try q4b fallback for reranking.
maya: creating ticket ML-2487 for golden-add-longctx-200 and regen with tokenizer v1 — https://redwood.atlassian/ML-2487
jordan: i'll run a paired t-test on sample-level diffs and post p-values by EOD.
anita: labelers — please prioritize ML-2487 gold labeling when queued. ping @labeling-team :bell:
maya: plan: (1) triage sample diffs (2) rerun qbringup with tokenizer v1 and alternative calib (3) if still regressed, temp roll to q4b rerank. aim to update canary by tomorrow. :hammer_and_wrench:
leo: :thumbsup:
